description: Lists curated page recipes: proven section sequences for complete landing pages (for example an agency, coaching or a hotel), each with its number of sections and a short purpose. Pass query to search by industry, purpose or section, for example 'hotel' or 'pricing'. Use it when the user wants a whole page rather than one section, then call get_recipe.

query.description: Search term (optional). Every word must appear in the slug, title, description or section names. Without it, every recipe is listed.

name: list_recipes
title: List page recipes
